Subject: Interested in a short product demo

Hi Marissa —

I signed up via the self-serve trial this morning and wanted to see if someone could run a quick demo to validate fit. A few notes up front so we don't waste time: 
- Use case: real-time product recommendations + 1:1 chat assistant in our web checkout flow
- Estimated monthly tokens: ~150M (peak concurrency around 30 req/s during promos)
- Timeline: pilot in 6 weeks, production in 14–16 weeks if things look good

Attaching a tiny usage snapshot and a short note on what we’d like to try. Ideally a 30–40 minute session with an AE who can speak to routing/cost controls and Dedicated options.

Thanks—
Liam
Director of Product, Cartly
liam@cartly.co

Hi Liam — great to meet you and thanks for the details. I'm Marissa on Growth — happy to run the demo (with Ben, our solutions AE, looped here). Quick follow-ups so we tailor the session: 

1) Are those 150M tokens mostly generations or heavy embedding usage as well?
2) Do you expect many long-context sessions ( > 1k tokens) per request or mostly short responses?
3) Any regulatory constraints (PCI, GDPR region-specific data residency) we should prepare for?

I can do a 30-min walkthrough + technical Q&A. Here are three slots (PDT) — pick one or send a preferred time and I’ll share a calendar invite: 
- Tue Apr 13 — 10:00–10:30
- Wed Apr 14 — 14:00–14:30
- Fri Apr 16 — 09:00–09:30

If you prefer self-book, here’s my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min

Looping Ben so he can prep a short demo focused on routing, batching, and cost controls. 

Best,

From: Liam Harper <liam@cartly.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-10T12:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a short product demo

Marissa — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Ben. Answers below: 

> Are those 150M tokens mostly generations or embedding usage as well?
Mostly generations (recommendation text + chat). We use embeddings for semantic search but that's ~10–15% of volume.

> Long-context sessions?
Most requests are short (<= 400 tokens); we have occasional longer sessions for support transcripts (~1.5k tokens) but they're infrequent.

> Regulatory constraints?
We’re a US-based e-comm brand; PCI applies to payment data (we never send card numbers to the model), and we prefer US-only data residency if available.

Wed Apr 14 14:00–14:30 (PDT) works for us. If Ben can show batching and a rough cost comparison vs. a baseline that would be ideal. Attaching a short doc with our top pain points.

—Liam
Attachment: cartly-pain-points.docx (DOCX, 34 KB)
